protocol.hypothesis: A directional touch and rejection of a causal EMA line may confirm frozen Dual ZigZag entries as dynamic support/resistance. Test EMA 9/20/50/100 on signal, completed daily and completed weekly sources, as an independent bounce and as confirmation of raw and fixed SMA20 ZigZag entries.

research_provenance.implementation: mechanical EMA support/resistance adaptation; not authored by Trendoscope

required_data: weekly OHLCV aggregated from completed daily bars
confirmed frozen price and RSI ZigZag events
protocol.availability_lag: Signal-frame EMA uses completed current close. Daily EMA uses only dates strictly before signal date. Weekly EMA uses only completed ISO weeks strictly before current ISO week. Signal and bounce are observed at bar close; fill next open.
protocol.signal_semantics: Per-stock long/short signal. EMA support is a bullish touch/rejection and nonnegative EMA slope; resistance is bearish mirror. Raw and SMA20 parent exit events are unchanged.
protocol.evaluation_unit: Independent per-stock experimental account. Compare selected combination against both fixed parent controls on identical stock/timeframe pairs.

mechanisms: unchanged frozen ZigZag plus prior-day SMA20
raw ZigZag entry conditioned on EMA bounce
SMA20 ZigZag entry conditioned on EMA bounce
entry_design.bounce_formula: Long: prior signal close >= prior EMA, abs(current low - current EMA) <= 0.5*ATR14, current close > EMA, EMA current > previous source EMA. Short: prior close <= prior EMA, abs(current high - EMA) <= 0.5*ATR14, current close < EMA, EMA current < previous source EMA. Only completed source candles.

confirmation_windows.recent5: bounce on current or one of previous five completed signal bars

not_applicable: EMA lines from lower source timeframe than signal

mechanisms: raw parent opposite event for raw and SMA20 controls and all combinations
opposite EMA bounce event for EMA-only ablation
not_applicable: new stop/target in this EMA confirmation experiment

protocol.parameter_rationale: EMA9 covers short reactions, EMA20/50 cover intermediate levels and EMA100 covers slow support/resistance. Same, previous completed day and previous completed week compare line scale. A fixed 0.5 ATR contact zone normalizes by volatility. Same-bar and five-prior-bar confirmation distinguish coincident touch from setup before ZigZag breakout. All declared values are tested without return-driven pruning.

untested_dependencies: EMA zone width other than 0.5 ATR

protocol.baseline: One 25% long buy-and-hold position on same stock/timeframe, next open. zz_raw and zz_sma20 are frozen controls.
protocol.signal_rule: EMA bounce is independently tradable. Combined entry retains raw or frozen SMA20 ZigZag event only if same-direction EMA bounce occurred on current or previous five signal bars. Rejected parent entries do not suppress original opposite exit events. No lookahead.
protocol.execution_timing: Completed-bar decision, next-open fill, 25% of equity per independent stock account.
protocol.holding_period: Parent variants until opposite raw parent event; EMA-alone until opposite EMA bounce.
protocol.cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
protocol.selection: Rank all fixed EMA settings by early history; check every setting against policy >10% latest trailing-12m and user >20% target. Compare selected combination with same-stock fixed SMA20 parent; do not replace existing virtual accounts based on seen history.
limitations: Late history already seen in parent and prior indicator experiments
EMA rule is new adaptation, not Trendoscope author trade rule
Corporate events, short borrow and exchange lots incomplete
